 How you’ll make an impact:

Job Type: Full-Time | Location: Texas | Department: Network | Reporting to:  Vice President, Network Engineering | Work Location Type: #remote #hybrid    IREN  is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference.  IREN ’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.   With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.   Our Network Engineering team builds the networks that power AI at scale. We design and run the high-performance fabrics that connect tens of thousands of GPUs, the backbone and WAN that link our campuses across continents, and the facilities networks that keep our data centers safe and running.   Our work spans all aspects of network engineering for  IREN , from the data center and core to the WAN and peering edge.   As a  Staff Network Development Engineer  you will set the technical direction for the software that runs  IREN 's network. You will architect the platforms that design, deploy, validate and operate our networks at global scale, lead the hardest engineering problems hands-on, and grow the network software capability of the team.  Responsibilities  
 Define the architecture and roadmap for  IREN 's network automation platform, from source of truth and configuration generation to deployment, validation and closed-loop remediation. 
 Design and build core services yourself, writing and reviewing production code in Python or Go. 
 Set the engineering standards for network software, including system design, testing, code review, CI/CD, release and reliability. 
 Lead the design of network telemetry, observability and analytics at scale, and use them to automate operations. 
 Lead the use of AI and machine learning in network operations, such as anomaly detection, troubleshooting assistants and automated change review. 
  
 Partner with network architecture, security and engineering leaders to make the network software-defined from design through operation. 
 Responsible for the safety of automated production changes, and lead incident reviews where software is involved. 
 Mentor senior engineers and grow the network software engineering capability of the team. 
  Requirements  
 Extensive experience as a senior or staff software, network development or site reliability engineer for large data center, cloud or hyperscale networks. 
 Expert software engineering skills in Python or Go, with a track record of designing and delivering distributed systems, services and APIs in production. 
 Deep experience with network automation platforms, data models such as YANG, streaming telemetry and closed-loop automation. 
 Strong BGP, OSPF or IS-IS, MPLS with traffic engineering, VXLAN and EVPN knowledge, and experience with large HPC and AI networks. 
 Experience with network platforms such as Cisco, Juniper and Arista, and their programmable interfaces. 
 A clear view on applying AI and machine learning to network operations. 
 Experience with NVIDIA Spectrum networking, RoCE or InfiniBand, HPC or GPU platforms is highly regarded. 
 The credibility to set technical direction, influence across teams and coach senior engineers. 
  Benefits At  IREN , we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. new_jobs.description:
SeatGeek  believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.   
 The Core Engineering department owns the infrastructure and networking that powers  SeatGeek.com  along with transversal capabilities in our stack ranging from application frameworks, developer experience to security and resilience.  
 As manager, you’ll lead one or more teams in core engineering, guiding the team as they transform a strong technical foundation into a resilient, user-focused product. Your role will be key in shaping the team’s roadmap, enhancing the developer experience, and driving faster, more reliable delivery across the company. 
  What you'll do  
 
 Manage a team of strong senior engineers 
 Own a transversal core engineering domain maintaining a high standard of operational excellence and driving tactical and strategic vision for this domain 
 Code and architecture reviews, and provide technical and design feedback to the team 
 Play an active role in our recruiting process, helping us grow our engineering team in any way you can 
 Provide regular job performance feedback, hold one-on-ones, and provide career development support to your direct reports 
 Work with your Technical and Product counterparts to form a compelling vision and direction for the team that aligns with organizational and business goals 
 Select new and work with existing technology vendors when necessary. You constantly make build or buy decisions together with your team 
 Communicate technical and product decisions to the right people, resolve blocking issues, and collaborate with other leaders across the organization 
 
  What you have  
 
 You’ve successfully built and led lean teams, ensuring they’re productive, motivated, and capable of delivering impactful results 
 You’re able to foster safe, collaborative & inclusive environments, where engineers feel empowered to do their best work 
 You’re great at shaping and driving complex, user-focused roadmaps, and keeping your team focused in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
 You're able to break down complex technical concepts and explain them clearly to non-technical audiences, accurately representing the team's work to a wide range of stakeholders 
 Knowledge of the technology industry to help your team make good tooling and framework decisions to set them up for success 
 You understand how to lead by setting context, facilitating collaboration, and getting buy-in between cross functional partners in product, design, engineering and leadership 
 You’ve worked as an Engineer in the past, are familiar with the challenges of that role, and preferably have had hands-on experience with the following: 
 
 Tooling across our tech stack 
 Building out highly available and distributed systems, especially in regards to container orchestration systems 
 
 
  Our stack  
 Experience with every technology listed isn’t expected, we’ve included them for transparency. What matters most to us is your core engineering skills and ability to learn, not deep expertise in any one tool or language. 
 
  Languages:  TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#, Go 
  Version control:  GitLab    
  Infrastructure:  AWS, Kubernetes / EKS, Terraform 
  Monitoring & Alerting:  Datadog 
  Networking : Fastly, Kong, Cilium 
 
  Perks  
 
 Equity stake 
 Discretionary annual bonus 
 Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely 
 A WFH stipend to support your home office setup 
 Unlimited PTO 
 Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave  
 401(k) matching  
 Student loan matching program 
 Health, vision, dental, and life insurance 
 Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care 
 $500 per year for wellness expenses 
 Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
